fieldValues.title: D3 Faceted publication
fieldValues.summary: Authoring, reading, generic fallback and website or print publication are explicit facets over canonical meaning; a publication adapter never becomes the only reader.
fieldValues.body:
## Group Need

We need to read, edit, print and publish the same document differently without duplicating or losing its meaning.

## Semantic Adds

- purpose-specific Views
- DocumentViews
- generic fallback rendering contract

## Blueprint Adds

- authoring facet
- reading and publication facets

## Does Not Introduce

- layout as canonical state
- a single View for editing and publication
- a required theme or website runtime

## Activation Trigger

A document must serve readers in more than one context while remaining recoverable without its preferred presentation.

## Research

- problem-index/08-rendering-export/default-rendering-baseline.md: A conforming reader needs a normative baseline when no View is available.
- problem-index/08-rendering-export/deliberation-export-separation.md: Authoring and publication Views have incompatible purposes and must remain separate projections.
